clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Yowler's Paw is brought to Verner Osgood as proof the feared gnoll leader is dead. Yowler leads the packs menacing the hills above Lakeshire.

Yowler leads the Redridge gnolls that terrorize the heights around Lake Everstill, their howls reaching Lakeshire. He is feared above all, a ruthless alpha driving the packs' expansion. Verner Osgood asks brave adventurers to bring him Yowler's paw, the customary proof of a bounty across human territories. Taking the paw marks the death of an unusually cunning predator and a blow against the chain of command among his disorganized followers.

Yowler's Paw points to the danger facing Lakeshire. The Stormwind Army is consumed by the Blackrock orc threat entrenched around Stonewatch Keep, leaving civil authorities and townspeople to hire passing mercenaries for defense. Without regular royal garrisons, settlers such as Verner Osgood rely on proof that threats have been dealt with to keep local roads marginally safe for trade and travel.
